Description: simple calendar and addressbook server Radicale is a CalDAV (calendar) and CardDAV (contact) server. . Calendars and address books are available for both local and remote access, possibly limited through authentication policies. They can be viewed and edited by calendar and contact clients on mobile phones or computers.
